prompt: You have been selected for a school team and your close friend, who trained just as hard, has been cut and is trying to congratulate you through tears. What response honours both your achievement and their disappointment?

options.text: Hide your joy completely and say the selection was all luck and unfair, so they feel better
Celebrate loudly in the moment and tell them in detail how excited you are about the season ahead
Thank them, acknowledge how hard they worked and how disappointing this must be, avoid bragging in the moment, and check in with them again in the days after
Avoid your friend until their feelings have settled down

explanation: You do not have to erase your achievement to care about their pain. Acknowledging their effort and checking in later shows the friendship matters more than one selection, without false modesty or rubbing it in.
